call_points.text: Prospective bid pipeline is about ₹2.5 lakh crore; management does not revise it quarter to quarter.
Q1 capex ₹170 Cr against a FY27 budget of ₹500 Cr, which management reiterated.
Steel and cement prices are flat, but petroleum-linked commodities, aluminium, copper and OFC cables have risen; 81% of contracts carry price-escalation clauses.
BharatNet has ₹6,500 Cr left to execute on a fixed-price contract; rising OFC prices may cut profit, and management is seeking client relief.
No FY27 guidance on revenue, margin or order inflow; management will revisit after Q1FY27.
Consolidated order book at 31 March 2026 was ₹83,004 Cr, up about 16% and the highest in the company's history.
Bid pipeline of prospective projects is close to ₹2.5 lakh Cr.
Working capital was ₹4,847 Cr, 28% of turnover, at 97 days.
About 74% of contracts carry escalation clauses, but management is unsure these fully cover the price rise.
An impairment of ₹21.3 Cr on the Oman investment was booked as an exceptional item, fully impairing international outstanding.
Analysts pressed repeatedly on the missing guidance; management said it needs a quarter of clarity and declined to give even a base-case execution level.

guidance.statement: No FY27 guidance on revenue, margin or order inflow; management will revisit after Q1FY27
FY27 order inflow guided at ₹22,000-25,000 Cr
FY27 capex budget of ₹500 Cr reiterated

operating_notes.text: Consolidated order book of ₹83,004 Cr at 31 March 2026 is spread across seven verticals with a book-to-bill of roughly 4x.
UP Jal Jeevan order book outstanding was ₹6,181 Cr at March 2026, with ₹1,730 Cr executed and receivables of ₹3,015 Cr including unbilled revenue.
The Pachhwara coal mining MDO project has a rated capacity of 15 MTPA, already achieved, with revenue upwards of ₹2,000 Cr.
Order book of ₹81,214 Cr comprises ₹71,312 Cr standalone and ₹9,902 Cr from subsidiaries, with orders spanning 2 to 7 years.
Ken-Betwa order value is ₹3,390 Cr, of which ₹116.35 Cr has been executed; the site is fully mobilised.
BharatNet has ₹6,500 Cr left to execute on a fixed-price contract; ₹185 Cr was recognised in Q1 and ₹620 Cr cumulatively.

timeline.summary: On its 16 May 2026 Q4FY26 call, NCC reported a record consolidated order book of ₹83,004 Cr at 31 March 2026 and cut debt by ₹729 Cr in Q4, but declined to give any FY27 guidance.
On its 7 August 2026 Q1FY27 call, NCC guided FY27 order inflow at ₹22,000-25,000 Cr, revenue growth of 8-10% and EBITDA margin of 8.5-9%, against an order book of ₹81,214 Cr.

watchlist.response: Management declined all guidance, citing an uncertain environment, and said it would revisit after Q1FY27; it also declined to confirm a base-case execution level.
watchlist.text: Analysts repeatedly asked for FY27 revenue, margin and order inflow guidance, noting peers had guided.

watchlist.response: About 74% of contracts have escalation clauses, but management was not sure these fully cover the price rise and flagged possible material availability issues.
watchlist.text: Whether rising input prices and logistics constraints would hit margins.

watchlist.response: The rise is due to smart meter SPV loans consolidating; standalone stays as is, SPV disbursals may add a little.
watchlist.text: Whether the consolidated finance cost jump would recur.

watchlist.response: ₹780-800 Cr certified in early July; milestone-based contracts and BSNL billing should smoothen it over two quarters.
watchlist.text: Unbilled revenue growing faster than revenue

watchlist.response: ₹1,461 Cr is smart-meter project debt and ₹160-170 Cr is HoldCo equipment capex loans.
watchlist.text: Consolidated debt jump of about ₹1,900 Cr YoY

watchlist.response: May reduce profit rather than cause a loss; management is in talks with the client and ministry for a resolution.
watchlist.text: BharatNet fixed-price contract with rising OFC prices

watchlist.response: ₹50 Cr received, balance expected at 15% a month; matter is sub judice and management declined to say more.
watchlist.text: Telangana Mission Bhagiratha receivables of about ₹180 Cr

watchlist.response: No FY28 guidance; management said it will speak after FY27 is complete.
